summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return detailing a share award exercise (10,000 new shares at USD 5.33 on June 3, 2026) and extensive share repurchases for cancellation from March 20 to April 10, 2026, totaling over 10.4 million shares at prices ranging ~USD 6.58–6.82 per share. This constitutes an open-market buyback program returning capital to shareholders, with no board recommendation or advisor named. The filing is a routine HK exchange disclosure of ongoing capital returns; watch for continued buyback activity and potential cancellation impact on EPS.
